one_line: A set of crude, craftable makeshift tools (screwdriver, crowbar, wirecutters, wrench, welding tool) that players build from junk like metal rods, cans and beer — slower and, for the crowbar, breakable.
player_facing_mechanics: Craft an improvised screwdriver from 1 metal rod (5s)
Craft an improvised crowbar from 1 metal rod (10s)
Craft improvised wirecutters from 2 improvised screwdrivers (8s)
Craft an improvised wrench from 2 metal rods using a welder (15s)
Craft an improvised welding tool from a soda can, 10u beer, a pipe, a power cell and cable coil using a screwdriver (15s)
Use improvised tools for their tool functions (screwdriving, prying, cutting, wrenching, welding) but slower than real tools
Improvised crowbar breaks after a limited number of uses, leaving an 'oddly bent rod' trash item and making a metal-drop sound
Improvised welding tool runs on beer as fuel (10 max), can be refilled with a screwdriver, cannot be manually turned off once lit, and uses match-strike/wirecutter sounds
tg_systems_used: tool behavior framework (TOOL_SCREWDRIVER, TOOL_WELDER and the use_tool() chain)
weldingtool fuel/activation framework (max_fuel, can_disable, activation_sound, change_icons)
data_only_parts: All item stat overrides: name, desc, icon, icon_state, toolspeed, custom_materials, random_color
Broken crowbar trash item stats (name, desc, icon/icon_state)
Crowbar var config: durability = 10, broken_type = /obj/item/trash/broken_crowbar, break_sound
Welder config: max_fuel = 10, reagent_fuel = beer, activation/deactivation sounds, can_disable = FALSE, toolspeed, change_icons = FALSE
All five /datum/crafting_recipe definitions: result, time, reqs, tool_behaviors, category
logic_parts: crowbar/improvised/use_tool() override: post-use durability decrement and break-out behavior — spawn broken_type at user's loc, play break_sound, qdel self when durability hits zero
Inherited behavior relied upon: welding tool consuming/refilling beer as reagent fuel via screwdriver and the one-way activation
byond_specific: DreamMaker .dmi icon files (surfshack13/icons/improvtools.dmi) and icon_state strings
qdel(src) and new broken_type(user.loc) object instantiation at break time
port_notes: Mostly data: item prototypes (screwdriver, crowbar, wirecutters, wrench, welder) and recipe YAMLs (Construction/RecipePrototype with tool quality and material/stack requirements) can be authored directly in SS14 once equivalents for improvised tools, rods, cable coil and beer fuel exist. The only real logic is the crowbar's use-count durability, which maps naturally to a dedicated component plus a system that listens for tool-use events (or an event raised after a successful tool DoAfter) and deletes/spawns the broken prototype on depletion; the welder's beer-fuel, no-disable behavior fits Reagent- or fuel-based components. A human must decide whether improvised tools are distinct entities or variants/qualities of existing tools, how slow tool speed is modeled (tool quality/time multiplier), how the rod-based recipes convert to the SS14 construction/materials model, and whether the crowbar's break RNG/ durability should be a component or a generic tool-durability system.
